name: mirage
text: Written down as task BC and I'm starting on it. What I know now: only ONE engine run is live (no old runner holding a connection), so the likelier cause is count: BoltOdds allows 3 connections; the engine takes 2, and your phone's own sockets or a Test probe make 3+. A cancelled run can also leave a socket half-open. I'll (1) find who holds the connections, (2) make STOP ALL, engine off, pause scanning and an API toggle off close that API's sockets, (3) close sockets when a run ends or is cancelled, (4) stop a 'too many connections' refusal from marking your key refused. I'll tell you when each ships.
